## Source

Lives at [`git-sutras/`](https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts/tree/main/git-sutras)
in the repo. Two tiers:

- **`git-sutra-core`** — platform-agnostic alias definitions, no external
  dependencies. Install via `git-sutra-core/install.cmd` (Windows) or
  `install.sh` (Unix).
- **`git-sutra-pro`** — high-level interactive workflows. Requires
  [`fzf`](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf).
